Coastal lime kiln at Llanbadrig, Anglesey

Its original function was for burning limestone, from the adjacent quarry, the coal was imported by ship. The lime produced from this process was then spread on fields to enhance their productivity and counteract the naturally acidic soils of the area. The lime was also used for making lime mortar for building work.

name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps 1939 layout
description:
The Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, utilized from 1921 to 1978, was a fearsome, 14.1-kilometer (8.76-mile) public-road triangle. Revered as one of the fastest and most dangerous racetracks in motorsport history, it featured legendary, high-speed sections like the Masta Kink and the Eau Rouge/Raidillon complex, before being replaced by a shorter modern layout.

Designed in 1920 by Jules de Thier and Henri Langlois Van Ophem, the circuit used everyday public roads between the Belgian towns of Francorchamps, Malmedy, and Stavelot.

As racing vehicles became faster, the layout was modified to increase average speeds. In 1939, the slow hairpin at Ancienne Douane was bypassed by a steep, sweeping uphill left-right-left combination, creating the legendary Raidillon. Following World War II and damage sustained during the Battle of the Bulge, the circuit was renovated in 1947, bypassing the Stavelot intersection to create a faster, banked corner.

![](https://i.redd.it/tqoxahc80f931.jpg)

description:
3D scan of a statue representing the metal “Gold”. An androgynous figure rises from the gold-bearing quartz crystal at the base of the caryatid. It presents a crown and a necklace with a pendant on a ceremonial cushion. Gold is thus depicted as the ‘King of Metals’ and a symbol of supreme worldly power.

The figure was created by Rudolf Weyr (1847-1914) and is part of the decorative program in Hall IV of the Natural History Museum Vienna.

description: Se trata de una puerta de madera de doble hoja, de color marrón oscuro (posiblemente caoba o similar). La parte central, inmediatamente adyacente a la puerta, es de piedra de tono claro (beige o crema), con líneas de sillería horizontales y verticales bien definidas. La madera de la puerta presenta un relieve tallado con motivos vegetales o figurativos, particularmente notable en el centro y a la derecha de la puerta, junto a la manilla o pomo. La sillería de piedra a la derecha del marco tiene ventanas o nichos laterales con formas curvas y detallados relieves decorativos en la piedra.

name: Monastic Cell K2
description:
***Al-Rubaiat cells at Hosh Eissa*** are among the earliest landmarks of ***monasticism*** in Egypt, where the early fathers sought solitude and communion with God since the first centuries of Christianity. 
Their simple design reflects the spirit of asceticism, serving as places of prayer, meditation, and work, and standing as a living witness to the depth of the monastic heritage in the Beheira region.

It is called in Greek ***κελί*** and in Coptic ***katageion*** or ***xia***

***This Monastic Cell is located in Al-Rubaiat area in El-Beheira governorate, Egypt.***

This model is created from 2428 photographs (Nikon D5300) using Agisoft Metashape 2.2.1 Photographed in December 2023.

What it was: A large-scale, immersive art installation that occupied the Turbine Hall of the Tate Modern in London from 2003 to 2004.
Key components:
A large, semi-circular "sun" constructed from hundreds of mono-frequency lamps.
A ceiling covered in mirrors, which reflected the sun and the people below to create an illusion of a vast, infinite space.
An artificial mist that filled the room, creating a hazy and dreamlike atmosphere.
Purpose: To bring the outside world indoors and encourage viewers to think about their perception of nature, weather, and their environment. Eliasson also aimed to prompt reflection on themes like sustainability and urban disconnect from the natural world

description:
This scientifically accurate 3D model of Carnotaurus has been created by closely following fossil evidence and modern paleontological research. The body proportions, skeletal structure, and muscle anatomy are carefully reconstructed to reflect the real animal as accurately as possible. The skull features its characteristic short, deep shape with correctly positioned and sized horns, while the jaw structure conveys the powerful bite mechanics of this theropod. The extremely reduced forelimbs are modeled to match their limited mobility, and the strong, well-balanced tail highlights Carnotaurus’s ability to run at high speeds. Skin details are based on current scientific assumptions, featuring realistic scale patterns, natural folds, and subtle asymmetry, giving the model a lifelike presence suitable for high-quality renders, animation, and educational purposes.

name: Animated Carchradontosaurus
description:
This 3D model represents Carcharodontosaurus, one of the largest known theropod dinosaurs that lived during the mid-Cretaceous period (~100–94 million years ago) in North Africa.

The anatomy is based on current paleontological research, incorporating accurate skeletal proportions, muscle mass reconstruction, and posture consistent with large carcharodontosaurid theropods. The elongated skull features sharp, blade-like teeth adapted for slicing flesh,

Surface details include realistic skin folds, scale variation, and asymmetry to reflect a living animal rather than a stylized creature. The body proportions emphasize powerful hind limbs for locomotion, a heavy counterbalancing tail, and reduced but muscular forelimbs.

This model is suitable for scientific visualization, documentaries, educational projects, and high-end realistic renders.

name: Castillo Forga - Arequipa
description:
El **Castillo Forga**, ubicado en la ciudad de Mollendo, provincia de Islay, región Arequipa, Perú, es uno de los inmuebles más representativos del patrimonio arquitectónico de la ciudad. Emplazado sobre un promontorio frente al litoral, destaca por su singular arquitectura de carácter historicista, su volumetría y su estrecha relación con el paisaje costero de Mollendo.

Este modelo 3D busca contribuir a la documentación, conservación y difusión del patrimonio cultural, permitiendo explorar digitalmente las características arquitectónicas del inmueble y apreciar su valor histórico, urbano y paisajístico como parte de la identidad de Mollendo.

description:
This model is designed for **CNC machines.**
The model is optimized for the "Subdivision Surface" modifier.

The ".blend" file has a patina effect configured using "Ambient Occlusion."

This 3D model was created as follows:
Initially, a sketch was drawn on paper.
Then, using wood chisels and gouges, the corner elements and the central (round) part (530 mm in diameter) were cut out by hand.
Then (with minor modifications) a 3D model was created.
The photo shows different variations of this wood carving, with minor modifications.
I am the original author of these particular patterns shown in the photo. However, there are already copies and imitations available online.

Oryginał znajduje się w Krakowie, w dzielnicy Prądnik Biały.

Historia dworu sięga 1421 kiedy to pojawiają się pierwsze pisane wzmianki o dworze przy rzece Prądnik. Dzisiejszy wygląd zawdzięczamy generalnym remoncie o charakterze ratunkowym z roku 1829, kiedy XVIII wieczną, barokową bryłę rozebrano i pozostawiono typowy architektonicznie szlachecki dworek. W skład założenia dworskiego wchodzą również dwie oficyny, wschodnia i zachodnia.
We dworze gościli między innymi: Jan Kochanowski, Mikołaj Rej, Tadeusz Kościuszko czy Olga Boznańska (która uwieczniła go na swoich obrazach). Swoją pracownię w jego wnętrzach miał wybitny malarz historyczny Jacek Malczewski.

name: Stylized Diorama of a Cozy Neighborhood
description:
This 3D model presents a charming, stylized diorama of a residential neighborhood block rendered in a high-fidelity voxel (3D pixel) art style. The asset features a cluster of nine unique houses arranged around a central cottage, emphasizing a cozy, simple aesthetic with sophisticated lighting and texture.

**Model Description**
This modular environment kit features a collection of suburban-style houses with a hand-painted feel. Each structure is meticulously crafted from voxels, creating a textured, tactile appearance reminiscent of classic sandbox games or tabletop miniatures.

The set includes a variety of gable-roofed homes, cottages, and small villas. Architectural details like chimneys, dormer windows, and recessed entryways are built directly into the voxel grid.

The houses are situated on a unified baseplate featuring paved sidewalks, grassy patches, and small shrubbery, making it ready for use as a level prop or a standalone isometric diorama.

For more **visit** https://linktr.ee/zirconiumapps

name: Kissing Bug (P. howardi ♂) - Bejuco, Ecuador
description:
This male kissing bug (*Panstrongylus howardi*) was collected in Bejuco, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Panstrongylus howardi* is an endemic species for Ecuador (restricted to the Manabi province) and a secondary vector of Chagas disease.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.2 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: Kissing Bug (T. carrioni ♀) - Loja, Ecuador
description:
This female kissing bug (*Triatoma carrioni*) was collected in Loja province, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Triatoma carrioni* is a vector of Chagas disease in the south of Ecuador and in the north of Peru.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.3 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: Hippopotamus amphibius - MNCN22307
description:
**Description**: The common hippopotamus is a semi-aquatic marvel, with a skull designed to keep its eyes, ears, and nostrils above water while the rest of its massive body remains submerged. As the third-largest land mammal, the hippo's skeletal structure is a masterclass in supporting immense weight both on land and in the buoyant environments of African river systems.

**Specimen**: *Hippopotamus amphibius*  (Linnaeus, 1758)

**Inventory number**: MNCN-22307

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Mamíferos. Curator: Ángel Garvía (colecciondemamiferos@mncn.csic.es)

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/mamiferos).

Scanned with an Artec Eva in 2020 by Carlos A. Palancar.

name: Swimmer from Doctor Who
description:
Swimmers were immense transcendental beings which dwelt in the Void between universes. They were so vast that universes burst against their sides like bubbles against a whale. One and the hermit released the Fendahl Predator to prevent Swimmers from being attracted to the universe. (PROSE: The Taking of Planet 5) They were also known as intercreationals. (PROSE: The Book of the War)

The Eighth Doctor considered Swimmers to be among the predators that could eat him while he was drifting through the Time Vortex unprotected. (PROSE: The Shadows of Avalon)

The loa Baron Samedi, his "wife" Maman Brigitte, and Spinning Jenny were Swimmers. According to Homeworld agent Cobden, Swimmers were merely another form of Leviathan that disturbed the "waters of reality" merely by existing. (PROSE: Spinning Jenny)

This is a true sized and highly detailed model of a young charming red cat. It will add life and coziness to any architectural visualisation of houses, playgrounds, parques, urban landscapes, etc. This model is suitable for game engine integration, VR/AR content, etc.

**Technical specifications:**

* digital double 3d scan model
* 150k & 30k triangles | double triangulated
* high-poly model (.ztl tool with 5 subdivisions) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher
* sufficiently clean
* PBR textures 8K resolution: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps
* non-overlapping UV map
* no extra plugins are required for this model

Download package includes a Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, OBJ, FBX, STL files, which are applicable for 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you will find in the “Tex” folder, included into the main archive.

**3D EVERYTHING**

**Stand with Ukraine!**

name: Kissing Bug (P. chinai ♂) - Loja, Ecuador
description:
This male kissing bug (*Panstrongylus chinai*) was collected in Naranjo Adentro, Loja province, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Panstrongylus chinai* is a vector of Chagas disease in the south of Ecuador and in the north of Peru.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.3 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: Vampirical Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

The Vampirical Blight Drone is a blood collecting *Beetle Rubigenum Drone* that works in Vampiric Blight hives, storing blood and delivering it to the Queen and her eggs. In desperate times, drones will often cannibalize each other to feed the Queen and her eggs.

**Other Things to Note:**  *Vampirical Drones coat the tunnels of their hives with blood to make for a more habitable environment. Biohazard equipment recommended.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Vampirical Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/vampirical-blight-queen-943c5865b9f94ce48ccea253382c0d77)

name: Great white shark jaw
description:
“Great White Shark jaw” (https://skfb.ly/WsOI) by NHM_Imaging is licensed under CC Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs ([http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/]

This is a laser scan of a Great White Shark jaw which was originally reported as coming from an 11 metre-long (36 feet) shark, though subsequent analysis by the Museum estimates it at about 7.5 metres (25 feet) – still a very large fish! The specimen demonstrates the incredible rows of spare teeth that Great Whites have lined up inside their jaw. If a tooth is lost the next one in line just folds up to take its place. The specimen was used for public engagement for many years and has suffered as a result.

name: Dante Confronting the Three Beasts
description:
**Dante e le tre fiere** – una scena simbolica dell’Inferno (I, 31-60), qui ricreata in versione 3D.
Il pellegrino, smarrito “in una selva oscura”, viene respinto da tre animali che rappresentano gli ostacoli morali del suo cammino: lonza, leone, lupa, allegorie di **lussuria**, **superbia** e **cupidigia** che gli sbarrano il cammino.

Ed ecco, quasi al cominciar de l’erta,
una **lonza** leggiera e presta molto
che di pel macolato era coverta.

Ed ecco quasi al cominciar dell’erta
mi si mostrò un **leone**, che parea
che contra me venisse con la testa alta.

Ed una **lupa**… che di tutte brame
sembrava carca ne la sua magrezza:
e molte genti fé già viver grame.

La scena richiama il momento in cui Dante capisce che non può salvarsi da solo, preludio all’arrivo di Virgilio. Dante comprende che da solo non può salvarsi, preludio all’arrivo di Virgilio.

A cura di prof. Alessio Langella ITI via Degli Orti di Alghero

description:
La Stramonita haemastoma o Thais haemastoma es un molusco de la familia de Muricidae. Tiene la característica especial de soltar un líquido de color púrpura (azul violáceo). Este color era utilizado en la Antigüedad e indicaba poder. 
La presencia en los concheros de la Campa Torres, en Gijón, Asturias, parece indicar la producción a nivel doméstico de este tipo de tinte usado para aplicar en los tejidos y difundida desde tiempos fenicios.

name: Hirudinaria granulosa – Nervous System
description:
This 3D model shows the nervous system of the Indian cattle leech (Hirudinaria granulosa), a member of Phylum Annelida. The system is simple, ladder-like, and segmentally organized, adapted for coordinated movement and sensory response.

It consists of a pair of anterior cerebral ganglia (brain) connected to a double ventral nerve cord. Along the nerve cord, a series of segmental ganglia are present, each controlling specific body segments.

The leech also has sensory receptors for detecting touch, vibrations, and environmental changes.

This model is useful for studying annelid neuroanatomy, segmental organization, and basic nervous coordination.

The shell is box-shaped, with a low, forward-sloping apex that is not strongly coiled like that of the Glossidae genus. Found south of Okinawa, as well as in the Philippines, Indonesia, and New Caledonia. Found on gravel bottoms mixed with shells at depths of 5–60 m.

name: ツキヨミガイ / Glossocardia obesa
description:
殻は箱型、殻頂は前傾し、低く、コウボネガイ類のように強く巻き込まれない。沖縄以南、フィリピン、インドネシア、ニューカレドニア。水深5～60ｍの貝殻混じり礫底。

The shell is box-shaped, with a low, forward-sloping apex that is not strongly coiled like that of the Glossidae genus. Found south of Okinawa, as well as in the Philippines, Indonesia, and New Caledonia. Found on gravel bottoms mixed with shells at depths of 5–60 m.

和名：ツキヨミガイ

英名：Glossocardia obesa

学名：Glossocardia obesa (Reeve, 1843)　フナガタガイ科　Trapezidae

殻長：4.8㎝

参考文献：「日本近海産貝類図鑑」【第二版】奥谷喬司 編著 東海大学出版部（2017年1月）

References：Illustrated Guide to Shellfish of Japanese Coastal Waters [Second Edition] Edited by Takashi Okutani Tokai University Press (January 2017)

name: OPH2028  Carcharodontosaurid maxilla
description:
# Description:
OPH2028a consists in a partial left maxilla belonging to a large carcharodontosaurid from the Kem Kem Compound Assemblage. This specimen contributes to ongoing research on the diversity and evolutionary relationships of North African theropods.

* **Locality and horizon:** Kem Kem Beds, Morocco – Cenomanian, Late Cretaceous
* **Institution:** OPHIS Museo Paleontologico e Centro Erpetologico
* **Reference:** [Paterna A. and Cau A. (2022).](https://l1nq.com/OaOCs)


For further details and access to the 3D model, please visit [OPHIS Museo Paleontologico](https://ophis.info ), or send an e-mail to info@ophis.info

* 3D model and Scan: [Simone Saccomandi](https://sketchfab.com/SimoneSaccomandi)
* Supervision: [Mario Falasca](https://sketchfab.com/marfal)

description:

Leedsichthys was a gigantic filter-feeding fish that lived millions of years ago, and this model is designed to capture its unique size and elegant movement through ancient seas. Perfect for prehistoric environments, documentaries, animations, games, scientific visualization, and 3D collections.

This model is created for artists, developers, and dinosaur or marine life enthusiasts who want to add a legendary Jurassic ocean creature to their projects.

name: KIRIK KIRIK SENJA (CHESTNUT-HEADED BEE-EATER)
description:
Kirik-kirik senja merupakan burung ramping berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh sekitar 18–20 cm. Ciri khasnya terletak pada kepala dan tengkuk berwarna cokelat kastanye, menyerupai rona cahaya senja. Garis hitam tipis membentang dari pangkal paruh melalui mata, kontras dengan dagu kuning cerah dan tenggorokan biru muda yang lembut.

Bagian punggung dan sayap atas berwarna hijau zamrud berkilau, sedangkan perut hingga tunggir tampak biru kehijauan. Paruhnya hitam, panjang, dan melengkung ke bawah, proporsional dengan wajah berwarna kastanye dan mata merah tua yang tajam.

Ekor kirik-kirik senja tidak memiliki dua bulu tengah yang menjulur panjang, melainkan berujung rata dengan gradasi hijau keabu-abuan di bagian luar. Kakinya kecil, ramping, dan berwarna hitam keabu-abuan, berfungsi untuk mencengkeram ranting halus saat bertengger. Saat terbang, burung ini tampak anggun dengan sayap runcing dan pola warna yang kontras di bawah sinar matahari.

name: Green-banded urania (sunset) moth
description:
Urania leilus, the green-banded urania, is a day-flying moth of the family Uraniidae. The species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae. It is found in tropical South America east of the Andes, especially in the Amazon rainforest. Its range includes Suriname, Guyana, French Guiana, eastern Colombia, Venezuela, eastern Ecuador, Brazil, northern Bolivia, eastern Peru, as well as the island of Trinidad. It has been recorded as a vagrant to the central and northern Lesser Antilles, such as St. Kitts, Barbados and Dominica. Their preferred habitat consists of riverbanks, in primary and secondary rainforest, at elevations between sea level and about 800 m (2,600 ft).

Based of this model: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/madagascan-sunset-moth-5eb521c24f1c4aa6ad052ee4682cbd13

name: Etruscan seal (left femur)
description:
3D scan of the left femur of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: Green monkey
description:
3D scan of a skeleton of green monkey (*Chlorocebus sabaeus*). 

The green monkey is an Old World monkey which lives in in West Africa from Senegal and the Gambia to the Volta River in a wide range of wooded habitats, ranging from very dry Sahel woodland to the edge of rainforests. It is also commonly seen in coastal regions, where known to feed on seashore foods such as crabs. It also feeds on a wide variety of other foods, including fruits and invertebrates. Males typically being slightly larger than females measuring between 42 and 60 cm while the females between 30 and 49,5 cm.


Specimen: green monkey, *Chlorocebus sabaeus* (Linnaeus, 1766)

LiDAR-based 3D documentation of a mosaic floor fragment with Greek inscription from the Byzantine church at Tel Shiloh, now displayed at the Museum of the Good Samaritan, Holy Land.

The inscription reads: "Our Lord Jesus Christ have mercy on Shiloh and its inhabitants," serving as key archaeological evidence for the Byzantine identification of the site with biblical Shiloh. Two superimposed Byzantine churches (4th and 6th century CE) were excavated at Tel Shiloh, with mosaic floors bearing geometric patterns and Greek inscriptions. Before the first Temple, Shiloh was the central Israelite sanctuary, housing the Ark of the Covenant during the period of the Judges.

LiDAR scanning with Scaniverse (iPad Pro), processed for web delivery (109.4k triangles, 55.8k vertices).

Part of a practice documenting early Christian and Byzantine heritage sites in the Holy Land.

Museum of the Good Samaritan, Highway 1, Holy Land
Ref: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shiloh_(biblical_city)

Алтарь расположен значительно выше обычного уровня земли. Храм строился специально для того, чтобы уходящие на войну конные полки могли принимать присягу, исповедоваться и получать благословение, не слезая с лошадей. name: Guildhall3D -- An Introduction
description:
Learn more on: 

📰 [The Spatial Heritage Review](https://nebulousflynn.substack.com/p/announcing-guildhall-3d-with-cradle)

🌐  [guildhall3d.com](https://guildhall3d.com/)

With a story spanning a thousand years, London’s Guildhall – one of Europe's finest surviving civic buildings – invites visitors to reflect on the grand sweep of history it has witnessed.

Now, Guildhall3D draws you into a high-resolution scan of the Great Hall, enlivened with 23 data points tracing this story back to Roman London. Digital scanning brings this past alive, celebrating military triumphs and the deeper achievements of peace.

Supported by the City of London Corporation, the team of historians and 3D scanners at Cradle of English has fashioned an intimate tour of this iconic building, bringing centuries of history to the world.

This is the third Guildhall to stand here, resilient through fire (1666) and war (1945), reminding us in its profound quiet that the human spirit endures.

name: Lehariya Gate, City Palace of Jaipur, India
description:
LiDAR-based 3D documentation of the Lehariya Gate (Wave Gate) at Pritam Niwas Chowk, within the City Palace of Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Founded in the early 18th century by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, the City Palace is a major example of Rajput architecture with Mughal influences. Pritam Niwas Chowk contains four ceremonial gates, each associated with a season and a Hindu deity; the Lehariya Gate represents the monsoon, distinguished by flowing wave motifs drawn from traditional Rajasthani lehariya textiles and painted architectural ornament.

Capture: LiDAR scanning with Scaniverse (iPad Pro), processed for web delivery (297.7k triangles, 149.4k vertices). Geometry and ornament preserved for documentation, architectural study, and digital conservation. Part of an ongoing practice documenting at-risk architectural ornament across Gujarat and Rajasthan.

Ref: (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City_Palace,_Jaipur)

name: Kultura3D - Synagogue, Borderland town, Biłgoraj
description:
The synagogue is a replica of the 17th-century wooden synagogue of Volpa, located in Belarus. The synagogue, built in 1648, was burned down by the Germans during World War II. The synagogue was reconstructed thanks to a detailed inventory conducted in the 1930s by Szymon Zajczyk at the initiative of Professor Oskar Sosnowski of the Warsaw University of Technology.

The synagogue of Volpa was called by experts the most magnificent in Europe. The ornate synagogue, built in a style known as Jewish Baroque, served as a model for such buildings. The initiative to recreate it is all the more valuable given that not a single wooden synagogue survived the war in Poland – all were burned down.

description:
A massive steampunk house environment featuring two fully realized structures connected by a third-floor bridge, designed to feel both functional and chaotic in true industrial fashion. This project focuses heavily on dense detail work and layered storytelling through design.

The buildings are wrapped in an intricate network of pipes, pressure systems, and mechanical infrastructure, suggesting a self-sustaining energy system powered by boilers, steam flow, and experimental tech. Rooftops are packed with solar panels and exhaust systems, blending retro-futuristic engineering with a gritty, lived-in aesthetic.

Every surface was approached with intentional complexity, from overlapping materials, modular elements, and small mechanical details used to create visual depth and realism. From ventilation systems and scaffolding to interconnected pipework, the goal was to make the structure feel believable, functional, and constantly in motion.

I'd love to hear how you use this building!

name: Colonna Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta - Atri
description:
La terza colonna di destra della Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta di Atri (Teramo) conserva un ciclo di affreschi tra XIV e XV secolo, oggi perfettamente leggibili grazie al restauro.

Spicca la Madonna adorante il Bambino (1465) di Andrea De Litio, esempio raffinato di devozione rinascimentale locale. Accanto si trovano opere tardogotiche di scuola senese, come una elegante santa martire (forse Palazia) e una Madonna con Bambino attribuita al Maestro di Offida.

Di grande forza espressiva è il San Giovanni Battista di Antonio Martini, immerso in un paesaggio simbolico, mentre la scena con San Nicola e Santa Caterina d’Alessandria mostra influenze della pittura senese. Completa il ciclo un San Sebastiano della scuola del De Litio e un santo identificato tradizionalmente come Cristoforo.

name: relogio
description:
Relógio de pêndulo clássico em madeira, inspirado nos tradicionais “grandfather clocks”. A peça apresenta um corpo alto e elegante, com acabamento escuro e detalhes esculpidos que reforçam seu estilo vintage. O topo possui um frontão ornamentado, enquanto a estrutura é sustentada por colunas torneadas que emolduram a caixa principal.

O mostrador circular é destacado por um visor de vidro, revelando o pêndulo metálico e os pesos internos, elementos característicos desse tipo de relógio mecânico. Na parte inferior, outro detalhe circular dourado adiciona equilíbrio visual ao design.

Este modelo 3D foi desenvolvido com atenção à silhueta e aos elementos decorativos, sendo ideal para composições de cenas históricas, ambientes clássicos ou visualizações arquitetônicas. name: Kilpeck Church South Door
description:
The south door draws attention first. It is alive with figures and foliage patterns. There are warriors, birds, snakes or dragons, monsters, and, near the top, an angel. The work is fluid, sophisticated and beautifully carved. The doorway is fantastically well preserved; until Victorian times it was protected by a porch. Now it is exposed to the weather, but monitored very carefully for signs of wear.

The church is small, built of red sandstone, and set on the edge of the village, with beautiful Herefordshire countryside stretching away on all sides.

name: Secret of Evermore Teleport machine
description:
Fanart of my favorite SNES game ever.

This piece was fully sculpted in Adobe Medium inside VR.

Despite being largely discontinued, it still offers one of the most intuitive workflows I’ve used for 3D sculpting — especially compared to more complex, less beginner-friendly tools like ZBrush.
The project took about 2 days alongside a workshop I was teaching on the same topic. The same game also inspired the name of my VR animation studio: LAVAMACHINE.

Pipeline:
•	Sculpting in VR (Medium) 
•	Retopo / export (~1M polys) 
•	Texturing in Substance 3D Painter 
•	Lighting & rendering in Blender 

For me, VR sculpting remains one of the most direct and playful ways to explore form and spatial storytelling.

With a little more render magic here (Lighting & Particles and Fog  with Blender): https://youtu.be/SYO8GkB3xs8

If you're interested in XR workshops or immersive art workflows:
https://ericgiessmann.com/vr-workshops/

More of my work:
https://ericgiessmann.com/

name: Կուսանաց անապատ Кусанац Анапат (Пустынь Дев)
description:
Кусанац Анапат (Пустынь Дев) в Старом Шинуайре — это уникальный памятник, который был одним из немногих женских монастырей в средневековой Армении. Находится на северо-западной окраине Старого Шинуайра (Հին Շինուհայր), на склоне Воротанского ущелья. Церковь Сурб Аствацацин (1676 г.): Сердце монастыря. Это трехнефная базилика, построенная из грубо отесанного базальта. Помимо церкви, сохранились руины жилых помещений монахинь, трапезной и подсобных зданий. Весь комплекс обнесен стеной.
Կուսանաց անապատը (նաև՝ Շինուհայրի անապատ) Սյունիքի միջնադարյան ճարտարապետության և հոգևոր կյանքի ուշագրավ հուշարձաններից է։ Այն գտնվում է Հին Շինուհայր գյուղատեղիի արևմտյան մասում՝ Որոտանի կիրճի բարձրադիր լանջին։ Սուրբ Աստվածածին եկեղեցին կառուցվել է 1676 թվականին, սակայն տեղում եղել են ավելի հին հոգևոր կառույցներ (4-5-րդ դարեր)։ Սա եղել է կուսանոց-մենաստան, որտեղ ապրել և գործել են միանձնուհիներ։ Այն Սյունիքի սակավաթիվ կուսանաց անապատներից մեկն էր և սերտորեն կապված էր Տաթևի վանքի հետ։

name: Darbas Церковь Сурб Степанос Սուրբ Ստեփանոս
description:
Дарбас — это живописное село в Сюникской области Армении, расположенное в регионе Сисиан в ущелье реки Воротан. Название «Дарбас» (Дарпас) в переводе с армянского означает «ворота». Согласно летописям, в XV веке Дарбас был крупным процветающим поселением, в котором насчитывалось 7 церквей и около 700 семей. на сегодня в селе Дарбас находятся два известных религиозных объекта, представляющих разные эпохи: Церковь Сурб Степанос (Святого Стефана) - построенная в 2010 году и руины церкви Сурб Аствацацин (Святой Богородицы), возведеная в XIII веке.
Սյունիքի մարզի Դարբաս գյուղի Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցին ժամանակակից հայկական եկեղեցաշինության վառ օրինակներից է: Եկեղեցին իր դռներն է բացել հավատացյալների առջև 2010 թվականին:  Կառուցման համար օգտագործվել է տեղական սրբատաշ քար (տուֆ կամ բազալտ): Ունի գմբեթավոր սրահի հորինվածք՝ արևելյան կողմում տեղակայված խորանով: Դարբասի Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցին վերականգնել է գյուղի հարուստ միջնադարյան հոգևոր ավանդույթները. ըստ պատմական աղբյուրների՝ 15-րդ դարում Դարբասն ունեցել է 7 եկեղեցի:

name: Gremio de Sant Esteve | BARCELONA
description:
Catedral de Barcelona | Gremio de Sant Esteve | BARCELONA

Del gremio de los Esteves se tienen noticias desde el siglo XIII. Los osarios datan de 1647, según indican las propias inscripciones. Además de la capilla de la catedral, el gremio poseía una sede en la calle Freneria que le dio nombre. Esta calle comunica la zona del ábside con la calle Llibreteria. La sede estaba al inicio de la calle más próxima al ábside. Por este motivo, la corporación disfrutaba de un exclusivo privilegio que denotaba su importancia social: una puerta, hoy inexistente, permitía entrar directamente desde la calle a la capilla, que de este modo quedaba comunicada con la casa gremial de Freneria.

name: Silverstone Circuit 2024 layout
description:
The Silverstone Circuit is a motor racing circuit in England, near the Northamptonshire villages Silverstone and Whittlebury. It is the home of the British Grand Prix, which it first hosted as the 1948 British Grand Prix. The 1950 British Grand Prix at Silverstone was the first race in the newly created World Championship of Drivers. The race rotated between Silverstone, Aintree and Brands Hatch from 1955 to 1986, but settled permanently at the Silverstone track in 1987. The circuit also hosts the British round of the MotoGP series.

The Silverstone Circuit is on the site of a Royal Air Force bomber station, RAF Silverstone, which was operational between 1943 and 1946. The station was the base for the No. 17 Operational Training Unit. The airfield's three runways, in classic WWII triangle format, lie within the outline of the present track.

name: Proteção de Torno com Grade de Segurança
description: Projeto de proteção para torno mecânico, constituído por estrutura de grade de segurança instalada ao redor da máquina, conforme configuração apresentada, com a finalidade de impedir o acesso involuntário às zonas de perigo durante a operação. A proteção será projetada considerando os riscos associados às partes móveis e rotativas, incluindo mandril, eixo, transmissão, ferramenta, peça em usinagem e possíveis projeções de materiais. O projeto será desenvolvido de acordo com os requisitos aplicáveis da NR-12, ABNT NBR ISO 12100, ABNT NBR ISO 13857 e ABNT NBR ISO 14120, considerando distâncias de segurança, resistência mecânica, fixação, estabilidade e condições de acesso para operação, limpeza, inspeção e manutenção. Quando houver acesso por portas ou portinholas, serão avaliados dispositivos de segurança e intertravamento aplicáveis. Serão elaborados desenhos técnicos, detalhes construtivos, especificações dos materiais e orientações para fabricação e instalação da proteção.

Jedná se o jeden z mála dochovaných pozůstatků původní stavby, která byla postavena v době, kdy město spadalo pod vládu rodu Švábského, a to až do roku 1265, kdy bylo dobyto Otakarem II.

Es uno de los pocos restos del edificio original, construído cuando la ciudad estaba bajo el dominio de la casa de Suabia hasta 1265, cuando fue conquistada por Ottokar II.

**ENG** A late Romanesque capital (13th century) decorated with human figures, originally from the Church of St Nicholas in Cheb (Eger), now on display at the Muzeum Cheb. It is one of the few remaining parts of the original building, which was constructed whilst the town was under the rule of the House of Swabia until 1265, when it was conquered by Ottokar II.

name: Molino del Miedo
description:
Torre molinar en ruina parcial. conocida como Castillico del Miedo. Situada en una loma al sur del monte Carmolí, a unos 12 metros s. n. m., en el campo de cartagena. Cronología probable entre los siglos XVIII y XIX. Declarado como Bien de Interés Cultural en 2007.

Volumen de cono truncado, diámetro exterior aproximado de 9 m. Muros de mampostería vernácula, con un grosor progresivo desde unos 2 metros en la base hasta 1 metro de espesor en la coronación. Carece de cubierta ni de maquinaria del antiguo uso como molino harinero, no tiene revocos ni acabados, tanto exteriores como interiores.

Al modelarlo se realiza un corte superior completamente horizontal, a cota 8,73 metros, para evitar artefactos por falta de cobertura fotográfica superior. Pese a ello reproduce con fidelidad proporciones, texturas y el estado de conservación actual.

name: Plutei, Biblioteca Malatestiana (Cesena, Italy)
description:
***Plutei*, Biblioteca Malatestiana (Cesena, Italy)**

The Biblioteca Malatestiana, founded in 1452 by Malatesta Novello, is the oldest civic library in Europe still preserved in its original setting. Its cypress wood reading desks, known as plutei, were designed to hold manuscripts on slanted surfaces, with benches attached for readers. Each book was chained to the desk, ensuring accessibility while protecting the collection.

name: Eltz Castle - Interactive Mini-Model
description: An interactive mini-model of Eltz Castle, North-Rhine Westphalia, Germany. It was built over many centuries and achieved a farytale-like form in which it is preserved - and still inhabited - until today. It is one of the most impressive and long-standing castles in Germany, and when I saw it for the first time in a random social media post, I thought it would be AI. I was so flashed that I immediately embarked on building a detailed 3D-model, my first mini-model, during which I developed the characteristic mini-model style of combining self-generated textures with simplistic, decorative normal maps. I consider it a fairly good model, seeing that it was my first time, but obviously I was not yet able to do any realistic foliage - ignore the horrible tree in the courtyard please.

name: Whirligear - playground
description:
**The Whirligear Playground**

Tucked between ivy-covered brick walls and old cobblestone paths lies Whirligear Playground—a wondrous place where imagination runs on gears, levers, and a hint of steam. Towering brass towers with winding staircases invite kids to climb up and peer through polished glass scopes.

Spinning wheels, clanking contraptions, and puffing vents bring the whole playground to life. The swings are suspended from copper pipes, squeaking delightfully with every arc. A carousel powered by foot pedals spins children in brass-seated pods shaped like airships and beetles.

There’s even a giant ticking clock face kids can climb, its hands moving just slowly enough to offer a thrilling ride. Whistles blow, chimneys puff, and laughter echoes through metal tubes shaped like dragons.

Every surface gleams with golden bolts and rivets, and even the benches are made of warm wood and riveted iron. It's a world of playful invention—where imagination clicks, clanks, and whirs with wonder.

name: Flagellazione di Piero della Francesca
description: La Flagellazione di Cristo di Piero della Francesca non è semplicemente un'opera d'arte, ma un vero e proprio manifesto scientifico. Il dipinto traduce in immagini i principi del trattato dell'artista, il De prospectiva pingendi, applicando allo spazio una precisione geometrica e matematica di livello ingegneristico.L'intera composizione è regolata dalla sezione aurea, che divide verticalmente la tavola in due parti proporzionali: lo spazio chiuso del portico a sinistra e la scena aperta con i tre personaggi a destra. Questa rigorosa armonia è supportata da una prospettiva a punto di fuga unico, in cui tutte le linee architettoniche del soffitto e del pavimento convergono verso un solo centro, posizionato all'altezza della cintola di Cristo.

name: REQUIEM
description:
Requiem  https://www.artstation.com/araghulijanyan
I'm happy to present my work titled “Requiem.”
The main goal in terms of meaning was to achieve a sense of generalization — but without slipping into abstraction. There are many details I reflected on, and I tried to make the sculpture look interesting from different angles, with symbolic weight not concentrated in a single spot. Still, the center of the whole composition — as the most perfect form, or perhaps an allegory of the Earth — is a small sphere held in the hand of a figure, or perhaps shown to us.
The sculpture was created in ZBrush, and rendered in KeyShot.
I designed the sculpture with the intent that it could be 3D printed or carved directly in stone. Of course, some additional technical adjustments may be needed for a real-world statue.
Overall, this work was a meaningful and valuable experience for me — one that I intend to develop further in future projects.
Thank you!

name: Lasca retocada 2 - Cueva de Galindo 1
description:
Se trata de un instrumento sobre soporte de lasca. La presencia abudante de cortex en su cara dorsal permite identificar que la matria prima es una riolita de color café claro que fue obtenida de un canto rodado de río . Este último rasgo distingue a la tradición tecnológica expedita del sitio Cueva de Galindo, Cañón de Molino, Durango, de donde procede. El arte rupestre de este espacio ha sido ubicado como parte de la Tradición Pictórica del Arcaico (2000 a.C. - 600 d.C.). Esta clase de herramientas con un retoque unifacial, es decir, presenta en una sola de sus caras y en un borde únicamente, es muy característico de este contexto, sin que se haya podido documentar o inferir hasta ahora la producción de instrumentos bifaciales.

Más información: 
http://dx.doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.35225.53605

Proyecto: "Arte rupestre y paisajes culturales en el Durango prehispánico: estudio comparativo de dos antiguos humedales", aprobado por el consejo de arqueología

Elaboró: Dr. Daniel Herrera Maldonado.

name: ALEX BOYA WALKING BREAD TURBINE (1)
description:
This grotesquely whimsical 3D head is part of Walking Bread, an absurdist dystopian universe by filmmaker and illustrator Alex Boya. Sculpted as a polygonal .glb asset, the model depicts a lumpy, half-human, half-loaf form — a surreal bread zombie whose facial structure collapses between organic anatomy and baked crust. Its bulbous nose, asymmetrical ears, and cratered surface read like a post-apocalyptic pastry gone sentient.

The design emerges from Boya’s signature “genomic animation” aesthetic, where biology, industry, and the culinary collide into strange hybrid organisms. In Walking Bread, this head embodies themes of consumption, transformation, and absurd survival, drawing influence from body horror, Eastern European surrealism, and handmade sculpture traditions.

Optimized for real-time viewing in GLB format, this version features low-poly topology with subtle shading to capture depth and eerie presence. Ideal for integration into AR/VR scenes, game environments, or as an interactive exhibition piece

name: Oxhead-Decorated Inscribed Bronze Li (牛头纹带盖伯矩鬲)
description:
Bronze Li Food Vessel Inscribed by Bo Ju with Oxhead Ornaments is a 3,000-year-old Western Zhou bronze food vessel. It stands 33.0 cm tall, 22.9 cm in diameter, and weighs 7,500 grams. Its design centers on vivid oxhead decorations: the lid knob is formed by two 3D calf heads facing opposite directions; the lid surface has raised oxhead motifs with upward-curving horns; the neck is patterned with six flat-angle thunder patterns; each of the three pouch-shaped feet displays an oxhead (horns protruding above the vessel surface). Made via piece-molding (body cast first, then decorations attached), the details are lifelike. A 15-character inscription appears on both the inner lid and neck wall: it records that Lord Yan granted Bo Ju cowries, so Bo Ju made this vessel to honor his father.

伯矩鬲是一件有 3000 年历史的西周青铜食器，通高 33.0 厘米、口径 22.9 厘米、重 7500 克，以生动的牛首装饰为核心：盖钮由两个相背的立体小牛首组成，盖面饰有角端上翘的浮雕牛首纹，颈部饰六条平角雷纹，三只袋状足各饰牛首纹且牛角上翘高于器表。器物采用分铸法制成，先铸器身再拼接附件，纹饰细节鲜活逼真。盖内与颈部内壁均铸有 15 字铭文，记载了燕侯赏赐伯矩贝币，伯矩因此铸器祭祀父亲的事迹。
